description: A dark-skinned, hairy-headed, small-bodied hominin climbs a mossy tree trunk in a dense tropical forest, gripping with hands and bare feet. A large limestone cave mouth with hanging vines is at left, ferns in the foreground. Painterly, shafts of light. The figure is unclothed but smooth and anatomically reticent, with no genitals shown. No text, no frame, no blood.
